findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: get_confounders · Public sink: get_blog_post, get_confounders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: get_confounders · Public sink: get_blog_post, get_confounders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
